description: Pattern (c32, owner direction U13 "끼릭끼릭 탁탁"): the same request on the same scratch project, three ways. engine-path: flags none, the engine reads the request, calls egdesk_run_command, waits, writes. decision-first: EGDESK_DECISION_FIRST=on, code builds the options from the folder (npm test, ...), the Decision model picks one (warm about 0.3 s), EG-Desk's own runner runs it, the arbiter reads it healthy from the runner's summary line, and the turn ends locally with NO engine turn (decisionFirst path fast, engineTurns 0); no assistant text (no new words). decision-first-failing: the same flag on a project with one failing test: the command ran before the engine, the arbiter reads it unhealthy, and the engine is asked ONCE with the result as context: it writes the explanation and needs no tool call (noToolCalls). The latency of each turn is in the record (subTurns[0].latencyMs): compare engine-path with decision-first. Needs --decisions; no model is asked for the fast path except the Decision model.
